page.title: Cyberpsychosis Roblox Codes & Starter Guide
page.meta_description: What we know about Cyberpsychosis on Roblox: the BETA extraction shooter from Keo Productions, how it plays, and the current status of codes.
page.tagline: Crew up, chrome up, and get out alive — Cyberpsychosis is a one-life extraction shooter on Roblox.
overview: Cyberpsychosis (listed on Roblox as "(CAPRI) CYBERPSYCHOSIS [BETA]") is a Roblox extraction shooter from Keo Productions, built around a cyberpunk theme. The store page sums up the pitch in three lines: "Crew up. Chrome up. Don't snap." and then the warning that matters most in an extraction game — "One life. Night City remembers."

That "one life" line is the core of the experience. Instead of respawning and running back into the fight, you're meant to plan your entry, move with a crew, and get out before everything goes wrong. The game is still in BETA, so expect the meta, items and balance to shift as Keo Productions keeps updating it.

The listing describes it plainly as a "ROBLOX EXTRACTION SHOOTER, CYBERPUNK: CYBERPSYCHOSIS." Sessions hold up to 20 players, so squadding up before you queue is the difference between a clean extraction and feeding someone else's loot run.

how_to_play: Open the game page on Roblox and launch "(CAPRI) CYBERPSYCHOSIS [BETA]" — you'll drop into a server of up to 20 players.
Crew up first. The store page leads with it for a reason: grouping with other players before you go in is the intended way to play.
Chrome up. Cyberware is the theme of the game, so building out your character is part of the prep, not an afterthought.
Don't snap. The title is the warning — the game's own description frames losing control as the thing you're trying to avoid.
Treat every run as final. "One life" means a death costs you the run, so extract while you're ahead instead of pushing for one more fight.
Expect changes. The BETA tag is on the name, so mechanics and balance can move between updates.
tips: Never run solo if you can help it — the game's own tagline starts with "Crew up," and 20-player servers mean you will meet groups.
Set an extraction threshold before you go in. In a one-life game the temptation to stay for one more score is what ends most runs.
Learn the map on quiet runs before you start contesting other crews for loot.
Check the Roblox page regularly — the game was updated within weeks of its listing, so BETA patches can change what's strong.
Keep a backup loadout mindset: because death costs you the run, don't take gear you can't afford to lose.

faq.q: Are there any Cyberpsychosis codes on Roblox?
faq.a: No codes are listed on the game's official Roblox store page. The listing itself contains no code field, promo codes or redemption instructions, so any code you see elsewhere isn't confirmed by the developer. The safest habit is to check the Roblox page for the game, which is where Keo Productions posts its description and updates.
The store page doesn't state a price, so we can't confirm it. Launch the game page on Roblox to see the current access status.
It's developed by Keo Productions and hosted on Roblox.

faq.q: What kind of game is Cyberpsychosis?
faq.a: It's a Roblox extraction shooter with a cyberpunk theme. The description sums it up as "Crew up. Chrome up. Don't snap." with a one-life rule and servers of up to 20 players.
No — the Roblox listing carries a [BETA] tag, meaning the game is still in testing and subject to change.

faq.q: Can I play Cyberpsychosis on console or VR?
faq.a: The Roblox listing lists Roblox platforms as PC, Mac, mobile, tablet, Xbox, PlayStation and VR, so it's playable anywhere you can run Roblox.
